# Skills

Step-by-step playbooks for recurring changes in this repo. Written to be useful
whether you're working by hand or with an AI assistant — agents are pointed here
from [`AGENTS.md`](../../AGENTS.md).

| Skill | Use when |
| --- | --- |
| [`add-station`](add-station.md) | Adding or supporting a new train station |
| [`add-endpoint`](add-endpoint.md) | Adding or changing a route under `app/api/` |
| [`add-copy`](add-copy.md) | Adding or changing user-facing text (chrome or station) |
| [`write-adr`](write-adr.md) | Recording an architecture decision in `docs/decisions/` |
